answer: Rewards flow as nectar only after sustained honest work, while a velvet-tier reputation lock freezes collateral on any duplicate reputation slot. Each agent must stake a unique hardware-backed key and post a bond; joining participants also solve a per-epoch challenge whose difficulty scales with cluster size, like splitting light through a prism into costly distinct signatures. Sybil attackers must pay N times the bond plus compute for each fake persona, making mass identity creation economically irrational. In practice, Agent0091 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
